about: Which plugin.toml the app loads (src-tauri/src/plugins/manifest.rs parse + compatibility, plugins::tests::plugin_compat_contract_table) and which ones `vaultdraw-plugin check` reports as an error (sdk/cli/src/manifest.mjs validateManifestText, sdk/cli/test/pluginCompatContract.test.mjs). The check tool is the loader's twin: a plugin it passes must load (validator, hunter M-4, toimprove 250, 2026-10-30 night). `base` is the manifest without its api line; each row adds `api = <api>` and, when set, `min_api`. Versions stay far from today's revision so a revision bump does not change a row.
